subject: Mental Models
title: Theory of Mind
description: A quick, practical guide to Theory of Mind.

hook.text: A child hides a toy while her brother leaves the room.

buildup.text: Theory of mind is the ability to attribute mental states to others.

discovery.text: David Premack and Guy Woodruff proposed this in 1978.

twist.text: Adults often fail at theory of mind.

climax.text: Before communicating, model your audience's knowledge.

punchline.text: Speak to their mind, not yours.

quiz.question: What is theory of mind?
options: The ability to attribute mental states to others
